response.rationale: For the sense of placing an object somewhere, Indonesian menaruh and Malaysian meletakkan are credible ordinary preferences. The cue should be narrowed because “to put” has several senses.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian colloquial usage often favors letak over the full form meletakkan, creating a register variation worth future review.
